summary: Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc. files Form 6-K reporting closing of a US$309.5M equity financing package, comprising a private placement with Canada Growth Fund, Investissement Québec, and ENI raising ~US$213.16M at US$1.84/share, and a concurrent bought deal public offering of subscription receipts raising ~US$96.49M. The escrow conditions were satisfied, releasing proceeds to fund the Phase-2 Matawinie Mine. The company confirms a final investment decision for the mine. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K reports capital raising to fund operations, not a special-situation event.
